
#represent sample to map of 19 Vietnam provinces 

```{r}
#READ EXCEL FILE OF DATASET 3: SAMPLE IPNT WHICH OUCRU SEQUENCED SUCESS

dataset3 <- read_excel("data/sample_pos_2019_2022_IPNT_sequencesucess_official.xlsx")

# ============================================================
# 2.  DOWNLOAD MAP OF VIETNAM LEVEL PROVINCES
# ============================================================

vietnam_province <- geodata::gadm(
  country = "VNM",
  level = 1,
  path = tempdir()
) %>%
  st_as_sf()


# ============================================================
# 3. FUNCTION STANDARDISE PROVINCE NAME
# ============================================================

normalize_name <- function(x) {
  x %>%
    stringi::stri_trans_general("Latin-ASCII") %>%
    toupper() %>%
    gsub("[^A-Z0-9]", "", .)
}


# ============================================================
# 4. COUNT PROVINCE IN DATASET
# ============================================================

province_count <- dataset3 %>%
  filter(!is.na(province)) %>%
  count(province, name = "n") %>%
  mutate(
    province_key = normalize_name(province)
  )


# ============================================================
# 5. STANDARDISE NAME PROVINCE IN MAP 
# ============================================================

vietnam_province <- vietnam_province %>%
  mutate(
    province_key = normalize_name(NAME_1)
  )


# ============================================================
# 6. MATCH DATA NUMBER OF SAMPLE AND MAP
# ============================================================

map_data <- vietnam_province %>%
  left_join(
    province_count,
    by = "province_key"
  )

# ============================================================
# 7.  Filter 19 provinces of central of VN
#    FOLLOW THE OLD MAP (BEFORE 2025)
# ============================================================

central_provinces <- c(

  # Bắc Trung Bộ (6)
  "Thanh Hoa",
  "Nghe An",
  "Ha Tinh",
  "Quang Binh",
  "Quang Tri",
  "Thua Thien Hue",

  # Duyên hải Nam Trung Bộ (8)
  "Da Nang",
  "Quang Nam",
  "Quang Ngai",
  "Binh Dinh",
  "Phu Yen",
  "Khanh Hoa",
  "Ninh Thuan",
  "Binh Thuan",

  # Tây Nguyên (5)
  "Kon Tum",
  "Gia Lai",
  "Dak Lak",
  "Dak Nong",
  "Lam Dong"
)

# standardise name province
central_keys <- normalize_name(central_provinces)

# filter map
map_central <- map_data %>%
  filter(province_key %in% central_keys)


# ============================================================
# 8.  Visualize map central VIETNAM
# ============================================================

p_central <- ggplot() +

  # Province polygons
 geom_sf(
  data = map_central,
  aes(fill = n),
  color = "grey50",
  linewidth = 0.05
)+

  # Color scale
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    option = "C",
    na.value = "grey90",
    name = "Number of DENV WGS"
  ) +

  # Coordinate system
  coord_sf(
    crs = st_crs(4326),
    default_crs = st_crs(4326),
    xlim = c(103.5, 110),
    ylim = c(10.5, 22.5),
    expand = FALSE
  ) +

  # Coordinate breaks
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(104, 110, by = 2)
  ) +

  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = seq(12, 22, by = 2)
  ) +

  # Title and axis labels
  labs(
    x = "Longitude",
    y = "Latitude",
    title = "Central Vietnam Map- 2019-2022",
    subtitle = "DENV Whole Genome Sequence Distribution",
    caption = "Source: GADM | OUCRU"
  ) +


  # Background and theme
  theme(
    plot.background = element_rect(
      fill = "#f0f0f0",
      color = "#f0f0f0"
    ),

    panel.background = element_rect(
      fill = "#f0f0f0",
      color = "#f0f0f0"
    ),

    # Coordinate grid
    panel.grid.major = element_line(
      color = "white",
      linewidth = 0.3,
      linetype = "solid"
    ),

    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),

    # Border
    panel.border = element_rect(
      fill = NA,
      color = "grey40",
      linewidth = 0.6
    ),

    # Title
    plot.title = element_text(
      size = 15,
      color = "grey20",
      face = "bold"
    ),

    plot.subtitle = element_text(
      size = 12,
      color = "grey20",
      face = "italic"
    ),

    plot.caption = element_text(
      size = 7,
      color = "grey50",
      face = "italic"
    ),

    # Axis
    axis.title = element_text(
      size = 9,
      color = "grey30"
    ),

    axis.text = element_text(
      size = 8,
      color = "grey30"
    ),

    # Legend
    legend.title = element_text(
      size = 14,
      color = "grey30", face = "bold"
    ),

    legend.text = element_text(
      size = 12,
      color = "grey50"
    ),

    legend.key.height = unit(0.7, "cm"),
    legend.key.width = unit(0.6, "cm"),

    legend.background = element_rect(
      fill = "#f0f0f0",
      color = NA
    )
  )

# Display map
p_central

# ============================================================
# 9. SAVE MAP WITH 300 DPI
# ============================================================

ggsave(
  filename = "Dataset3_Central_Vietnam_Map.png",
  plot = p_central,
  width = 8,
  height = 10,
  dpi = 300
)
```

# represent sample to map of 19 Vietnam provinces and bar graph for sample sequences  
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(sf)
library(patchwork)

# ============================================================
# BAR GRAPH - RANKING BY PROVINCE
# ============================================================

bar_data <- map_central %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  filter(!is.na(n), n > 0) %>%
  group_by(NAME_1) %>%
  summarise(
    n = sum(n),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(n)


p_central_bar <- ggplot(
  bar_data,
  aes(
    x = n,
    y = reorder(NAME_1, n)
  )
) +

  # Horizontal bars
geom_col(
  aes(fill = n),
  width = 0.8
) +

scale_fill_viridis_c(
  option = "C",
  na.value = "grey90",
  name = "Number of samples"
)+

  # Number labels
  geom_text(
    aes(label = n),
    hjust = -0.3,
    size = 3.5,
    color = "black"
  ) +

  # X-axis
  scale_x_continuous(
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1))
  ) +

  # Labels
  labs(
    x = "Number of dengue cases",
    y = NULL,
    title = "Number of DENV WGS"
  ) +

  # Theme
  theme_minimal() +

  theme(
    plot.background = element_rect(
      fill = "#f0f0f0",
      color = NA
    ),

    panel.background = element_rect(
      fill = "#f0f0f0",
      color = NA
    ),

    panel.grid.major = element_line(
      color = "grey85",
      linewidth = 0.3
    ),

    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),

    plot.title = element_text(
      size = 15,
      color = "grey20",
      face = "bold"
    ),

    axis.title.x = element_text(
      size = 10,
      color = "grey30"
    ),

    axis.text.x = element_text(
      size = 8,
      color = "grey30"
    ),

    axis.text.y = element_text(
      size = 9,
      color = "grey30"
    )
  )


#3. Ghép bar graph vào bên cạnh bản đồ
# ============================================================
# COMBINE MAP + BAR GRAPH
# ============================================================

p_central_combined <- p_central +
  p_central_bar +

  plot_layout(
    widths = c(1, 1.2)
  )

# Display
p_central_combined
ggsave(
  filename = "Central_Vietnam_Map_Barplot.png",
  plot = p_central_combined,
  width = 15,
  height = 10,
  dpi = 300
)
```

#map SAMPLE IPNT SEQUENCED SUCESS MAP TO WHOLE VIETNAM

```{r}
# ============================================================
# 7.  JOINING DATA AND KEEP ALL PROVINCE OF VIETNAM (GHÉP DỮ LIỆU VÀ GIỮ TOÀN BỘ TỈNH VIỆT NAM)
# ============================================================

# map_data đã được tạo ở các bước trước:
# - vietnam_province: ranh giới tất cả tỉnh Việt Nam
# - province_count: số mẫu của dataset3 theo tỉnh

map_vietnam <- vietnam_province %>%
  left_join(
    province_count,
    by = "province_key"
  )


# ============================================================
# 8. VISUALISE MAP VIETNAM WITH ALL PROVINCES 
# ============================================================

# ============================================================
# VIETNAM PROVINCE MAP - DATASET 3
# Background + coordinate grid
# ============================================================



p_vietnam <- ggplot() +

  # Province polygons
  geom_sf(
    data = map_vietnam,
    aes(fill = n),
    color = "grey50",
    linewidth = 0.05
  ) +

  # Color scale
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    option = "C",
    na.value = "grey90",
    name = "Number of DENV WGS"
  ) +

  # Coordinate system
  coord_sf(
    crs = st_crs(4326),
    default_crs = st_crs(4326),
    xlim = c(102, 110),
    ylim = c(8, 24),
    expand = FALSE
  ) +

  # Coordinate breaks
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(102, 110, by = 2)
  ) +

  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = seq(8, 24, by = 2)
  ) +

  # Title and axis labels
  labs(
    x = "Longitude",
    y = "Latitude",
    title = "Vietnam Map - Province Level",
    subtitle = "DENV Whole Genome Sequence Distribution",
    caption = "Source: GADM | OUCRU"
  ) +

  # Background and theme
  theme(
    plot.background = element_rect(
      fill = "#f0f0f0",
      color = "#f0f0f0"
    ),

    panel.background = element_rect(
      fill = "#f0f0f0",
      color = "#f0f0f0"
    ),

    # Coordinate grid
    panel.grid.major = element_line(
      color = "white",
      linewidth = 0.3,
      linetype = "solid"
    ),

    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),

    # Border
    panel.border = element_rect(
      fill = NA,
      color = "grey40",
      linewidth = 0.6
    ),

    # Title
    plot.title = element_text(
      size = 15,
      color = "grey20",
      face = "bold"
    ),

    plot.subtitle = element_text(
      size = 12,
      color = "grey20",
      face = "italic"
    ),

    plot.caption = element_text(
      size = 7,
      color = "grey50",
      face = "italic"
    ),

    # Axis
    axis.title = element_text(
      size = 9,
      color = "grey30"
    ),

    axis.text = element_text(
      size = 8,
      color = "grey30"
    ),

    # Legend
    legend.title = element_text(
      size = 10,
      color = "grey30",
      face = "bold"
    ),

    legend.text = element_text(
      size = 9,
      color = "grey50"
    ),

    legend.key.height = unit(0.5, "cm"),
    legend.key.width = unit(0.4, "cm"),

    legend.background = element_rect(
      fill = "#f0f0f0",
      color = NA
    )
  )

# Display map
p_vietnam


# ============================================================
# SAVE MAP
# ============================================================

ggsave(
  filename = "Dataset3_Vietnam_Map.png",
  plot = p_vietnam,
  width = 6,

  dpi = 300,
```
